limitations: Exact historical nomination order is unavailable; historical prices are replayed through explicitly generated orders.
Only historical players compatible with the current 2026 pool can enter a full current-roster simulation; coverage and buyer substitutions are reported by season.
Championship values are shadow rankings, not calibrated title probabilities.

marketModelComparison.cohort: all JUGG sales from 2021-2025; cohort membership is independent of every candidate feature
